name: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle
label: Quest
description: This bounty tasks adventurers with eliminating Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a rogue gnome overseer perched high above Cragpool Lake in the Stonetalon…
intro: This bounty tasks adventurers with eliminating Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a rogue gnome overseer perched high above Cragpool Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gerenzo has heavily augmented his decaying flesh with gears, clockwork machinery, and artificial limbs. The goblin engineer Ziz Fizziks seeks his mechanical arm as indisputable proof of his demise to earn a coveted promotion from his superiors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.
If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Look at that thing... It'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!
At least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
